question: Does activating Ertai's Familiar's ability stop it from phasing out for any reason, or only because of its own phasing?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it stops it from phasing out for any reason, not just its own phasing ability.
expected.answer: Activating the activated ability will prevent Ertai’s Familiar from phasing out for any reason, not just due to its own phasing ability.
